text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report presents the results of staff's investigation, at the request of the Etobicoke York Community Council, to determine the feasibility of traffic control signals at the intersection of Kirknewton Road and Hunter Avenue. Based on the study results, the installation of traffic control signals is not recommended as the Traffic Signal warrants have not been met.
Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Did NOT approve installation of traffic control signals at the intersection of Kirknewton Road and Hunter Avenue.
